invalid_client_configuration: The OAuth client credentials or configuration are invalid. Correct the client configuration and try again.
client_not_found: The requested OAuth client was not found in this tenant. Verify the client identifier and tenant, then try again.
invalid_request: The OAuth request is missing a required parameter or contains an invalid value. Correct the request and start the flow again.
invalid_grant: The authorization grant is invalid, expired, revoked, or does not match the client. Start a new authorization flow.
invalid_client: OAuth client authentication failed. Verify the client identifier and credential, then try again.
invalid_token: The access token is invalid, expired, or revoked. Obtain a new token before retrying.
insufficient_scope: The access token does not include the openid scope. Request the required scope and try again.
unsupported_token_type: This endpoint revokes refresh tokens only. Use token_type_hint=refresh_token.
server_error: The authorization server could not complete the request. Retry later; contact an administrator if the problem continues.
consent_required: The user has not consented to the requested scopes and this request cannot prompt for consent. Start the flow again without prompt=none, or grant consent first.
consent_not_found: You have not authorized this application, or the authorization has already been withdrawn. Reload the list of authorized applications to see the current state.
consent_prompt: This application is asking for access to your account. Review what it will be able to do before you decide.
scope_offline_access: Stay signed in when you are away
